column1: # Every card in the pipeline: TCGplayer product id, store URL, owned.
# owned is 1 or 0. 1 means the card is in the binders, and it is the default:
# a new card is owned unless someone says otherwise. 0 puts the card on the pull
# list (wishlist.html), with the decks that run it and how many to buy. There
# are no counts anywhere; how many a deck needs comes from its own deck list.
# add_cards.py writes this file. --need adds a card at 0 or flips one to 0,
# --have flips it back. normalize_cards.py then carries the flag into cards.csv.
